tagline: Daily care tracking at home: peg-tube feeds from pump readings, speech and physical therapy homework, and ice-cube counts — all on your own machine.
summary: Speech Therapy Tracker is a caregiver's daily log. **Tube feed** records each morning's pump snapshot (total infused, mL left in the bag, rate) against a formula catalog so daily calories come from what was actually delivered. **Speech therapy** holds the homework catalog — timed attempts or sets × reps — with a per-day log you can increment, skip or mark due from several screens; **consumption** counts things like ice cubes per day; **physical therapy** tracks exercises with sets, reps and weight.

Paper homework sheets can be photographed and imported: Claude vision reads the photo, you review the extracted exercises, then commit them. It was split out of My Health and shares the same local `my_health` Postgres database; the API binds to 127.0.0.1 only.
audience: Caregivers managing tube feeding and therapy homework for a family member.
Patients doing speech or physical therapy who want a simple daily checklist.
People who already run My Health locally (same database).
notFor: Medical advice or dosing decisions — it records what you enter.
Sharing with clinicians or syncing to a portal.
Network access — loopback only, no auth.

capabilities.title: Dashboard
capabilities.detail: `/dashboard` shows today's tube feed and exercises at a glance.

capabilities.title: Tube feed
capabilities.detail: `/tube-feed`: formula catalog (brand, kcal per 1000 mL, container volumes) and one pump snapshot per day (`PUT /api/data/feed-logs`).

capabilities.title: Speech therapy homework
capabilities.detail: `/speech-therapy` and `/speech-therapy-exercise-detail-page`: timed or sets/reps exercises with daily increment, skip and due.

capabilities.title: Photo import
capabilities.detail: Upload a homework photo; Claude vision extracts exercises (`/therapy-exercise-imports/preview`), you review and commit. Each call is logged with cost.

capabilities.title: Consumption
capabilities.detail: `/speech-therapy-consumption` counts items like ice cubes per day.

capabilities.title: Physical therapy
capabilities.detail: `/physical-therapy`: exercises with sets, reps and weight.

capabilities.title: Docs
capabilities.detail: `/docs` (getting started, security, open source, API reference).

components.name: Web app
components.owns: Landing, dashboard, tube feed, therapy, consumption and docs screens. Calls `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`.

components.name: API
components.owns: Therapy, consumption, physical therapy and tube-feed tables in `my_health` (`migrations/setup.sql`, `IF NOT EXISTS`), photo import with vision, AI ledger.
components.doesNotOwn: The rest of `my_health` — My Health owns those tables.

dataFlow: Point `DATABASE_URL` at the local `my_health` database and run `migrations/setup.sql` (safe to re-run).
The web app calls `/api/data/*` for every list, increment and snapshot.
Photo import: the image is uploaded in memory, resized with `sharp`, sent to Anthropic vision, previewed, then committed as exercises.

trust.title: Anthropic
trust.detail: Receives homework photos only when you use photo import.

commonTasks.title: First-time setup
steps: On the **API Express** repo, **Set up local database** — it targets `my_health`, shared with My Health.
Set `DATABASE_URL` (and `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` for photo import) in the API's Environment step.
Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` on the web to the API's real port.

commonTasks.title: Log this morning's feed
steps: Open `/tube-feed` and enter total infused, mL left and rate for today.
Check the day's calories on the dashboard.

commonTasks.title: Import new homework
commonTasks.when: The therapist hands you a new sheet.
steps: Review the extracted exercises, fix anything misread and commit.

troubleshooting.symptom: API won't start or clashes on port 3010/3011
troubleshooting.fix: The README ports collide with the studio gateway (3010) and Gmail storage (3011). Use the registry ports (API 3058, web 3059) and update `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`.
`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` isn't set, or the image is unreadable. Manual exercise entry still works.
Each click is an atomic increment; refresh before tapping again if the network was slow.

glossary.definition: One morning reading per day: total infused, mL left, rate.
Daily count of consumed items such as ice cubes.

hubNotes: Shares the `my_health` database with My Health — Hub's database setup for either project touches the same database.
README defaults (web 3010, API 3011) clash with the on-device gateway (3010) and my-gmail-manager storage (3011); prefer the registry's 3058 / 3059.
Repos live under `~/github/my-health/`, next to the My Health repos. My Health is removing its own copies of these features (uncommitted).
